description: Hint vectors (C-38). Each vector gives a check id, its sources set, a scope's files and a hint with paths; `expect` holds the hint's key (hex), the shape, the address, each path's token (hex), the content (hex) and its id, and what reading `bytes` (base64, as hushrun's writer wrote them) against the scope gives, with how many test files were dropped. `unread` lists bytes no reader takes; `noTests` bytes whose test files read and whose tests don't. `tools/refdigest.py unit-hints` computes them independently; the Rust code must agree.

vectors.name: pytest
vectors.description: Two test files, each with what it read; a lockfile in the scope that no test file read.

vectors.name: pytest-file-gone
vectors.description: The same hint, read where shop/cart.py is gone: test_cart.py, which read it, is dropped and runs.

vectors.name: go
vectors.description: Go packages, named by their directories, `.` for the root; one listed cart/testdata, the other the root (`""`).

vectors.name: vitest
vectors.description: Vitest's list of test files, of which src/old.test.ts is gone and leaves the list; non-ASCII paths.

vectors.name: empty
vectors.description: A hint of no test file.

vectors.name: pytest-tests
vectors.description: The pytest vector with tests, sealed: two with lists of their own that are one list, one that read its test file's, and one that read a lockfile.

vectors.name: pytest-tests-file-gone
vectors.description: The same hint, read where uv.lock is gone: every test file stays, and the one test whose list named uv.lock is dropped.

unread.name: not-zlib
unread.description: Bytes that aren't a zlib stream.

unread.name: truncated
unread.description: A hint cut one byte short: its Adler-32 is incomplete.

unread.name: trailing
unread.description: A hint with a byte after its zlib stream.

unread.name: bad-adler
unread.description: A hint whose Adler-32 is wrong.

unread.name: cut-content
unread.description: A content cut inside its token table.

unread.name: after-its-end
unread.description: A content with a byte after its end.

unread.name: index-past-tokens
unread.description: An index past the token table.

unread.name: count-past-bytes
unread.description: A token count larger than the bytes left, which a reader must refuse before allocating.

unread.name: bomb
unread.description: 17 MiB of zeros in a few KiB: inflating stops at 16 MiB.

unread.name: schema-v2
unread.description: A schema this reader doesn't know, hushrun.unit-hints/v2.

noTests.name: seal-flipped
noTests.description: The pytest-tests vector with its tag's last bit flipped: its test files read, with no tests.

noTests.name: seal-another-key
noTests.description: Its clear part, with tests sealed under another check's seal key: no tests.

noTests.name: plaintext-not-canonical
noTests.description: Its clear part, with a plaintext sealed under its key that holds a test with no id and leaves its lists unused: no tests.

noTests.name: seal-too-short
noTests.description: A hint with tests whose seal is shorter than a nonce and a tag: its test files read, with no tests.

noTests.name: lists-out-of-order
noTests.description: The pytest-tests vector with its first two tests' lists swapped: its test files read, with no tests.

noTests.name: v1-without-tests
noTests.description: A version 0 content under version 1's first line, with no tests' part: its test files read, with no tests.
